en: It's a quiet ruin... There's no\nsign of any mechanisms moving\nor anything making a nest here.

Coro was making a fuss about
an unnatural reaction here, so
we all came to check... but it
seems it was all for nothing.

Coro is a worrywart AI. He
exaggerates even the slightest
reaction, so this was probably
just another case of that,
right?

Don't let your guard down yet.
Even if these advanced ruins
look dormant, you never know
when they might spring to life.

Haha, experience really does
carry weight. But you're right...
I wonder what kind of ruins this
is.
Which planet did Coro say had\na "similar pattern"? Let's see,\nS...
Planet Stream. The planet\nwhere the Time Gate was...
...Del. To Fidel...
...? Rena, did you just call my\nname?
No? But I'm sure I heard a\ngirl's voice...
Ugh, what is this sensation?!
Ah, Fidel! I heard this place is\nfamous for fish dishes! Want to\neat some together?
Fidel_now: ...Miki!? Why are you\nhere! And what are you talking\nabout...?
Fidel_past: No... it's fine.
Jeez, you still can't eat fish? If\nyou keep being so picky, even\nRelia is going to laugh at you!
Fidel_now: W-what is this! Miki\nand... another me?
Fidel_now: No, I remember this.\nThis is the conversation I had\nwith Miki in Santerole...!
Fidel_past: I can eat fish! ...I\njust don't like it.
That's exactly what being picky\nmeans.
Are you still dwelling on that\ntime you ate the fish we\ncaught in the river?
Fidel_past: ...Ugh. Don't make\nme remember that...
They're gone... What was that\njust now? A vision? Or a\ndaydream...?
Fidel... Do you really hate fish?\nIt's delicious, so why?
Could everyone else see it\ntoo? And Lati, that's not the\nimportant thing right now!
...That strange sensation again!\nAnd the surroundings, too...!
This is impossible... Is this near\nSthal Village...? This is my\nhometown...!
Big brother Fidel still can't eat\nfish innards. Even though\nthey're delicious.
...Innards?
She means the entrails. Though\nwith small fish, they are often\ncooked without removing them.

Once, when Big brother Fidel
grilled a fish he caught, a worm
from the bait just popped right
out of the innards...!
Hey, don't make me remember\nthat!
It's such a waste, since the\ninnards are tasty.
...I remember that conversation,\ntoo. Just what is this ruin...?

*Pant... pant...* I somehow won...
But those enemies and that
place... everything felt so
familiar.

Yes. They vanished once we
defeated them, but they
certainly weren't illusions. You
felt it too, didn't you, Claude?

It was different from the Battle
Simulator, wasn't it? I wonder if
it's manifesting things from our
memories into physical forms.

But I didn't sense any malice.
The enemies had a strong
fighting spirit, but they felt like
they were just fighting
head-on...
Even the memories being\nreproduced... they felt, well, like\nthey lacked any ill intent.

...Don't worry about me.
Everyone knows I can't stand
fish. It doesn't matter now that
the reason is out...
...But still, why were only those\nspecific memories being\nreplayed? For what reason...?
Doctor: Captain, Dorne's\ncondition is...!
...That voice, I know it! Is this\nmy memory...? If so...!

...I knew it. Is this the Karnas
medical bay? Then Dorne, who
almost turned to stone, must
be in that transparent bed
over there...
...It's here. Ronyx... and my\nhelpless self from back then.
Doctor: Vital organs have\nbegun to petrify. The patient is\nin critical condition.
Dorne...!
...Mr. Ronyx. I... I have a\nrequest.
What is it?
...At least... let me spend my\nfinal moments at home...
Your final moments...? You're\nonly going to sleep for a little\nwhile.
But if you can't find the\nserum...
Please.
...I understand.
Prepare for transport.
Doctor: Yes, sir.
Please let us go with Dorne\ntoo!
You all are...
We'll definitely come back.
Actually, there's something I\nwanted to give you before the\nend.
What are you saying? You're\njust going to sleep for a little\nwhile...
Please, take that music box\nfrom the top of that shelf.
I want to give it to Millie.
But this is your sister's... I can't\ntake this.
Please... take it...
That's... for my sister... from...\nme...
It's okay. I promise I'll save you.
...Dorne!
Was that Lati's memory we just\nsaw? ...She must have gone\nthrough something terrible.

...Yeah. But it's okay. We've
overcome many hardships
since then. Dorne and his home
planet were both saved.

So, what we just saw... it was a
painful sight... but I think it was
a good opportunity to reaffirm
the happiness we have now.
I see... Lati is strong. No,\nperhaps she became strong\nthrough her battles...

...I'd heard stories about this
area from my father... but
seeing it for myself is a
completely different
experience.

Lati, I feel like I finally
understand why my father
trusted you and was always so
proud of you.

Heh, if these are the kinds of
memories, it's worth catching
glimpses of them. Let's explore
a little more.

...There must be a reason this
labyrinth recreates these
memories. Even without
malice... there is a purpose.

Are these fragments... of the
elements that make that
person who they are? If so,
then mine are...
Are you alright, Edge? You look\npale. If you're injured, I can\nprovide treatment...
Eh, no, I'm fine. It's just, I\nremembered something\nunpleasant...
...Ugh!
This is... the bridge of the\nSpace Pioneer Spaceship 003,\nthe "Karnas"... I thought so.

So "now" is around U.C. 10,
right after "that planet" was
destroyed... And the one
slumped in the captain's chair...
is me... from back then.

I saw it, just before we were
swallowed by the subspace...
The moment the distorted
Earth... vanished into the light...
Earth, which had miraculously\nbecome what it was over 4.6\nbillion years...
It was destroyed... in a single\ninstant... So easily...
It is impossible to stop a\nrunaway annihilation. No one...\ncould have stopped it.
That's right, no one could stop\nit! But... I'm the one who\ncaused it!
That's not true, Edge!
E-tan!
Edge worked so hard!
Stop trying to comfort me!
Even if that wasn't our Earth, it\ndoesn't change the fact that it\nvanished...
That's right... it all vanished! My\nwrong decision caused them to\ngo out of control!
Earth is gone! Not a single\nthing remains! Everything!
Everything!

Adults! Children! Animals!
Towns and houses, all of it! All!
All! All! Everything, everything,
everything!
Argh! Uaaah...!!
Stop it, E-tan! Please stop!

This isn't why I went out into
space... I did it for everyone's
happiness... for the sake of the
future...
And yet...!
Mista Edge, this is not your\nresponsibility alone. We are\nalso at fault.
He's right... None of us could\nstop them...
That's why, Edge...
If only I hadn't gotten involved...
If only I hadn't handed over our\ntechnology...
Edge! Edge, stay with me! If\nyou feel sick, it's okay to throw\nup!
I'm... I'm fine. I'm okay now. It\nwas just a reflex, I've calmed\ndown...
It's just... these materialized\nflashbacks are brutal...

Unlike my memories, this isn't
funny. And it won't be easy to
sublimate it like Lati did... I
suppose.
I'm sorry, Edge. If only I hadn't\ninsisted on continuing the\nexploration out of curiosity...!
...It's okay. What I experienced\nwas incredibly tragic and\nirreversible, but...

...It was worth it. We left a
mark on this universe. The
Uncharted Planet Protection
Treaty exists because of what
happened here...

...Yeah. That ideal has been
passed down until the year
U.C. 772. And I'll keep passing
it on. From now until forever...
...Yeah. I'm counting on you to\nprotect the future.

Come on, let's keep exploring.
If we can share and
understand each other's
precious memories... that
shouldn't be a bad thing.

Meeting Rena and everyone,
growing so much, saving the
universe... I have many happy
memories, but...

...The secret of my birth, the
destruction of my hometown,
the painful battles... I have
many painful memories too.
I'm a little anxious about what\nwe're about to see.
Ah... This is the shop in Aria\nVillage, my hometown. Opera is\nhere too...

I remember now...! This was
right after I met Claude. It was
when I was looking at
Accessories with Opera while
talking about someone I liked!
Hmm. So you haven't received\nany yet, Rena?

In that case, try acting a little
spoiled in front of the boy you
like. I'm sure he'll give you a
present...
...Let's see. For now, how about\nClaude?
If it's a request from cute little\nRena, I think he'd go out of his\nway for you, don't you?
Ehh...? If that happens, I'll be in\ntrouble!
Oh, really?
I mean it! I'd be so\nembarrassed!
You're actually happy about it,\nthough.

That's not true, I'm serious!
Even if I received something
from Claude, it would just... it
would really trouble me...
Ah...
Claude...
Hey, Claude...?
It seems like you two were in\nthe middle of something...
D-did you hear that...?
I-I have things to do, so...
W-wait! That's not it, Claude!
So sweet.
My skin is itching.
This is a completely different\nvibe from what I was shown...?

I'm blushing! I'm so
embarrassed by my own
innocence! It's frustrating that I
still can't be honest with
myself!

Ahh! Rena, who used to watch
calmly even when her
comrades turned her life into a
stage play, is now writhing in
embarrassment!?
I suppose the impact is\ndifferent when it's recreated\nusing one's own image.

(I feel like this is different from
my memories... but it might be
better for my mental health
not to dwell on it...)

Hmm, I don't know what the
criteria are for the ruins to
replay memories... but I have a
feeling I'll be the last one.

There are memories I'd rather
not share, but there's no point
in hiding them now. Though, I
hope it doesn't show me
making a mess of myself as a
kid.

I wonder how far back these
memories go? If it's millions of
years, could I even see
memories of my real mother...?

I wonder if it's only the past...
These ruins seem to have a
connection to the Time Gate,
so perhaps...
Is this... some noble's mansion?\nIt feels familiar, but I can't\nquite place it...
Ah, there's Adray and me over\nthere! And Clair... is she\npouring tea for me?
Well? Have you grown\naccustomed to life here yet?
Yeah. Pretty much... It's all\nthanks to you, Adray.
I see. That is good to hear.
By the way. Are you seeing\nthat girl from Nebel... Nel?
Wha... *cough, hack*. W-what\nare you asking so suddenly?!

You went through the trouble
of staying here. I was quite
certain that was the case... Am
I wrong?
N-No, it's not like that. It's\nnothing like that with Nel.

We met on this planet and
have adventured together...
How should I put it? Yeah,
she's like a comrade to me.
I see. Then, Master Fayt. Does\nthat mean you currently have\nno one you are seeing?
Not really... but why do you\nask?
I see, then this is perfect\ntiming. Would you care to\nmarry my daughter?
Whaaat!? With Clair?
What, is she not good enough\nfor you?
No, it's not that. But shouldn't\nshe be the one to decide that?
Even if I said I was okay with it,\nI don't know what Clair would\nsay...
What are you talking about? I\nknow my daughter well. There\nis no way she would refuse.
Alright, it's settled! Now the\nHouse of Razbard will be\nsecure.
Hm, Clair. What is it?

What!? You want me to come
along? Perfect. I actually have
something I need to discuss
with you as well...

I don't dislike Clair, but... if
that's the case, does that
mean that man is going to be
my father?
No matter how you look at it,\nthat's a bit much...
Fayt, when did things progress\nthis far? Anyway,\ncongratulations.

Have you told Sophia about
this? You need to settle your
previous relationships properly,
or it'll cause trouble!
...I don't know, I don't know! I\nhave no memory of this! Please\nbelieve me!

Most likely... these memories
aren't just the past. They
might include possible futures
or even parallel worlds.
I think so too. Considering the\nenemies and the battlefield, I\nbelieve Edge is right.

...If that's the case, this is a
precious ruin! I think we should
take more time and proceed
with the exploration cautiously!
True! Alright, let's head back\nfor now and go get the Captain\nand the others!
This is an incredible discovery.\nCoro's exaggerated reporting\nactually paid off this time!

I-I think it might be better to
destroy it before something
weird gets replayed... Actually, I
just want to destroy it...

I totally agree, and I can
imagine the chaos... but given
the atmosphere, I don't think
destroying it is an option...

This story has concluded. We
plan to release various other
stories in the future. Please
look forward to them.
